response: The criteria proposed by the International Association of the Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Groups (IADPSG) for screening for gestational diabetes mellitus are indeed cost-effective. This is because the model is most sensitive to the likelihood of preventing future diabetes in patients identified with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) using postdelivery counseling and intervention. Therefore, implementing these criteria can be a valuable investment in preventing long-term health complications associated with GDM.
